title: 第33章 来不及了，掏枪

第33章 来不及了，掏枪-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“加速。”

顾承安的声音没有太大的变化，怕吓到司机了。

司机没有犹豫，油门踩下去。

出租车从最外侧车道切入中间车道，速度从六十码拉到九十，顾承安盯着飞控画面——GL8已经驶下匝道，正在接近地面路口。

前方红灯。

GL8减速了。

货车同时驶下匝道，速度不减反增。

从无人机俯瞰视角，两条线正在交汇。

“再快。”

出租车猛地蹿了一下。

司机的手都有点发抖，但没松油门。

距离路口还有三百米。

顾承安已经没有时间再等了。

他侧过身，左手压住车门把手，右手探进背包——实际是从系统空间里取出了格洛克20。

上膛。

出租车下了匝道。

他推开车门的同时对司机喊了一声：“停车，不要熄火！”

车速降到二十码的瞬间，顾承安直接跨出车门，一个侧身站在路面上。

二百米外，那辆厢式货车从侧向路口闯过红灯，车头直冲GL8的右后方——撞击角度精准，完全冲着后排右侧的位置去的。

孙老坐在后排右侧。

顾承安快速举枪瞄准扣动扳机，一气呵成。

“砰——”

“嗙——”

货车左前轮胎爆裂。

巨大的车身在时速超过八十码的状态下瞬间失控，车头猛然向左偏摆，轮毂擦着地面刮出一串刺耳的火花。

整辆货车像被一只无形的手拍了一下，侧着身冲进路口外侧的绿化隔离带，连撞断两棵行道树之后轰然侧翻。

最危险的时候货车尾部擦着GL8的后保险杠掠过，间距不到半米。

GL8的驾驶员反应极快，方向盘一打，一脚地板油冲过路口，没有停车，直接加速驶离。

专业。

顾承安收回目光，调转枪口。

身后二百米，凯美瑞的驾驶员显然也看到了刚才那一幕——货车爆胎侧翻完全不在计划内，他猛打方向盘，试图掉头。

"Speed up."

Gu Chengan's voice didn't change much, for fear of scaring the driver.

The driver didn't hesitate and stepped on the accelerator.

The taxi cut from the outermost lane into the middle lane, and the speed increased from 60 to 90. Gu Chengan stared at the flight control screen - GL8 had driven down the ramp and was approaching the intersection.

Red light ahead.

GL8 slowed down.

The truck drove down the ramp at the same time, its speed increasing instead of decreasing.

From the drone's bird's eye view, the two lines are intersecting.

"Faster."

The taxi jumped suddenly.

The driver's hands were shaking a little, but he didn't let go of the accelerator.

There are still three hundred meters from the intersection.

Gu Chengan had no time to wait any longer.

He turned sideways, pressed the door handle with his left hand, and reached into his backpack with his right hand - actually taking out the Glock 20 from the system space.

Loaded.

The taxi got off the ramp.

As he opened the door, he shouted to the driver: "Stop, don't turn off the engine!"

The moment the car speed dropped to twenty yards, Gu Chengan stepped out of the car door and stood sideways on the road.

Two hundred meters away, the van ran through a red light at a side intersection, and the front of the truck went straight into the right rear of the GL8 - the impact angle was precise, and it went completely towards the right side of the rear seat.

Mr. Sun is sitting on the right side of the back row.

Gu Chengan quickly raised his gun, aimed and pulled the trigger, all at once.

"Bang——"

"Pfft——"

The front left tire of the truck burst.

The huge car body instantly lost control at a speed of more than 80 yards per hour. The front of the car suddenly swung to the left, and the wheels scraped the ground and scraped a string of harsh sparks.

The entire truck seemed to have been patted by an invisible hand. It rushed sideways into the green belt outside the intersection, broke two street trees, and then flipped over.

The most dangerous moment was when the rear of the truck brushed against the rear bumper of the GL8, with a distance of less than half a meter.

The driver of the GL8 reacted very quickly. He turned the steering wheel and kicked the floor oil as he rushed across the intersection without stopping and accelerated away.

major.

Gu Chengan withdrew his gaze and turned his gun.

Two hundred meters behind him, the driver of the Camry clearly saw what had just happened - the truck's flat tire and rollover were completely unplanned. He turned the steering wheel hard and tried to turn around.
